requests.title: Adopt the causa-storage 1.1.0 additive extension and a v4.1.6 successor that carries it
requests.question: Release causa-storage 1.1.0 with exactly the additive content of DOMAIN-CONTRACT.json proposedStorageExtension (6 new events: InvestigationDetailsRevised, ObservationRevised, HypothesisRevised, EvidenceRevised, EvidenceRelationshipRevised, EvidenceRelationshipWithdrawn; relationship kinds consistentWith and inconclusive), and compile a v4.1.6 successor of v4.1.5 with the matching CoreEvent cases and 7 CoreCommand cases including RecordConclusion?
options: A: release causa-storage 1.1.0 exactly as DOMAIN-CONTRACT.json proposedStorageExtension (6 new events, 2 new relationship kinds; no v1.0.0 change) and compile v4.1.6 = v4.1.5 + those CoreEvent cases + 7 CoreCommand cases (ReviseInvestigationDetails, ReviseObservation, ReviseHypothesis, ReviseEvidence, ReviseEvidenceRelationship, WithdrawEvidenceRelationship, RecordConclusion)
B: as A but only RecordConclusion now (no storage change), the rest after the competition; mark the 13 affected journeys as declared expected failures
C: amend the catalog to the v1.0.0 vocabulary (drop INV-023/025/027/029/034 and the two kinds)
requests.recommendation: A. Every proposed event is additive (§13.1): v1.0.0 histories read unchanged (CR-HIST-* stays green) and a v1.0.0 reader refuses the new data. B is the fallback if the freeze cycle cannot finish before kickoff.
requests.rationale: ODR-R10-26 A (recorded) commissions causa-data storage v1.1 for these fields; causa-data at e8259df has only contract/v1.0.0. v4.1.5 has the ConclusionRecorded event but no RecordConclusion command. Without both, 14 of 45 UI bindings have no defined write path (CONTRACT-READINESS.json).
requests.impact: Compatibility: Additive minor version; no migration; historical cases gain nothing (OD-HC-06 B: nothing is fabricated). Deferral: The competition builds against v4.1.5: journeys J1-03, J2-01, J2-03, J2-04, J2-05, J2-06, J2-07, J2-09 cannot round-trip the affected fields, and agents must not invent storage for them. Affects: INV-023, INV-025, INV-027, INV-029, INV-030 update, INV-031 consistent-with/inconclusive, INV-032, INV-033, INV-034, INV-035, INV-037.

requests.title: Evidence category on write
requests.question: UI-entered evidence must carry a category (EvidenceAdmitted.category, required closed enum), but no catalog field supplies one. How is it supplied?
options: A: add a required catalog field INV-045 'Evidence category' (select over the seven wire values)
B: UI-entered evidence is always stored with category document
C: causa-storage 1.1.0 makes category nullable for new evidence
requests.recommendation: A. It invents no meaning and the wire already defines the closed set.
requests.rationale: EvidenceAdmitted.category is a required closed enum (directObservation, measurement, log, document, experimentResult, testimony, externalReference); CAT-CAUSA-INVESTIGATION has no field for it, so AdmitEvidence has no input path.
requests.impact: Compatibility: A and B: none. C: a new event shape. Deferral: No evidence can be admitted from the UI without an agent choosing a category. Affects: INV-012, CMD-EVD-ADD.

requests.title: Evidence source reference: optional in the catalog, required on the wire
requests.question: The evidence source reference is optional in INV-028 but required non-blank on the wire (EvidenceAdmitted.source, R3.2 provenance). Which gives way?
options: A: make INV-028 required (catalog amendment)
B: causa-storage 1.1.0 nullable source for UI-admitted evidence
C: the UI writes a fixed placeholder (fabricates provenance; not recommended)
requests.recommendation: A. R3.2 already requires provenance for evidence.
requests.rationale: INV-028 required:false; EvidenceAdmitted.source is required non-blank text (R3.2 provenance). FIELD-MAPPING.md: 'Provenance: where it came from'.
requests.impact: Compatibility: A: none. B: new shape. Deferral: Evidence without a source is refused by the codec (CAUSA.SCHEMA_VIOLATION). Affects: INV-028, CMD-EVD-ADD.

requests.title: Conclusion strength on write
requests.question: A UI-recorded conclusion must carry a strength (ConclusionRecorded.strength, required enum), but INV-032/033 give only a statement. How is it supplied?
options: A: add a required catalog field INV-046 'Conclusion strength' (radio group over the five wire values)
B: UI-recorded conclusions are always stored with strength plausibleExplanation
requests.rationale: ConclusionRecorded.strength is a required enum (plausibleExplanation, leadingExplanation, supportedCause, confirmedCause, acceptedWithResidualUncertainty); INV-032/033 give only a statement. INVESTIGATION-SEMANTICS.md: 'conclusion strength and residual uncertainty are visible together'.
requests.impact: Compatibility: None. Deferral: No conclusion can be recorded without an agent choosing a strength. Affects: INV-032, INV-033, CMD-CONCL-RECORD.

requests.title: INV-011 'Hypothesis explanation' maps to HypothesisRecorded.mechanism
requests.question: Does INV-011 'Hypothesis explanation' map to the stored field HypothesisRecorded.mechanism ('proposed mechanism, if stated')?
options: A: confirm the mapping explanation = mechanism
B: a separate explanation field in causa-storage 1.1.0
requests.recommendation: A. mechanism is nullable, matching CF-03 A (optional on record).
requests.rationale: S04 'what it explains' vs the wire's mechanism ('Proposed mechanism, if stated', FIELD-MAPPING.md). No other wire field can hold it.
requests.impact: Compatibility: A: none. B: new field. Deferral: Agents must guess what the field means. Affects: INV-011, CMD-HYP-ADD, CMD-HYP-EDIT.

requests.title: INV-035 for evidence: which parts are editable with the same id
requests.question: INV-035 says an edited evidence item keeps its identifier; storage keeps admitted content immutable and corrects it by supersession to a new id. What may an evidence edit change while keeping the id?
options: A: label, source and URL are revisable with the same id (EvidenceRevised); content changes only by supersession (new id, relationships stay on the old item until reassessed)
B: content also revisable in place with the same id
requests.recommendation: A. It keeps evidence (the admitted original) distinct from its description and from interpretations.
requests.rationale: INV-035 says an edited evidence item keeps its identifier; causa-storage v1.0.0 corrects evidence only by EvidenceSuperseded to a new id; R3 and CONTRACT §5.5 keep admitted content immutable.
requests.impact: Compatibility: A: as proposed. B: breaks the immutability of admitted content. Deferral: J2-06/J2-09 evidence edits have no defined meaning. Affects: INV-035, CMD-EVD-EDIT.

requests.title: Adopt this contract package and its validator as owner-controlled verification assets
requests.question: Should this contract package (docs/contract-readiness/causa-precompetition, at the PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json pinned below) and its validator tools/contract-readiness become owner-controlled verification assets that a rehearsal runs from the governed checkout?
options: A: freeze the package (tag) as a governed verification asset, run from SRC like verification/ (route R2), and add `contract-readiness check --require-pass` to the T0 preflight
B: reference only; competition agents read it but nothing enforces it
C: fold the registries into the v4.1.6 successor package
requests.recommendation: A, with C for the parts OD-CR-01 compiles into v4.1.6.
requests.rationale: OD-INDY-22 forbids a rehearsal to copy code from earlier work; OD-HC-05 B chose route R2 (freeze checks as owner-controlled verification assets that the rehearsal runs from the governed checkout). This package is agent-authored and not frozen, and no Conditor, Praxis, Dokimos or Ordo step runs it today.
requests.impact: Compatibility: None on data or contracts. Deferral: Competition agents may consume it, but it has no governed status and its gate is advisory. Affects: COMPETITION-CONSUMPTION.md, tools/contract-readiness, every registry in this package.

requests.title: Actor identity for UI writes
requests.question: Every stored event carries an actorId that must be stable, non-secret and non-personal (CONTRACT §5.3); no contract says where the UI gets it. Where does it come from?
options: A: a fixed configured id per deployment, kind human: causa-operator
B: an opaque id derived from the GitHub account id (personal data; not recommended)
requests.rationale: actorId must be stable, non-secret and non-personal (CONTRACT §5.3); ActorContext = {ActorId: string} does not say where it comes from (DATA-REPOSITORY-CONTRACT.md S7). Rehearsal workspaces used 'live-test-operator'.
requests.impact: Compatibility: None. Deferral: Each agent picks its own actor id; histories differ between runs. Affects: F.Envelope.actor, every write command.
